statements.proposition: The new view classes added in this change have no impact on functionality (they are not used by any production code yet).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Impact claim. The 'do not need to deeply review' part is a reviewer suggestion; the checkable part is 'no impact on functionality'. Pre-existing code cannot reference classes new in this change, and none of the modified files' patches reference any new ResponseEntity*/Map*View class; the new main-source .java files carry no JAX-RS/@Provider/@Path annotations that would get them auto-registered. Static check only; reflection-based scanning not fully excluded.
evidence: gh api repos/dotCMS/core/pulls/32561/files: ~100 added view classes under dotCMS/src/main/java/com/dotcms/rest/...; modified main files are ErrorResponseHelper, ResponseEntityMapView, ResponseUtil, UserResourceHelper, DotRestApplication, ExceptionMapperUtil
Patches of all modified files: only raw-type -> diamond changes, a new ResponseEntityMapView constructor, typo fixes and @Tag edits in DotRestApplication; no references to any new view class
grep of added src/main .java patches for @Path/@Produces/@Provider/@Operation/@GET/@POST: no matches

statements.note: The 'adds fixes and View classes' part is true from the file list (many new *View.java; diamond-operator, typo and Postman 'language: json' fixes). The 'no impact' part is not settled by a concrete check: the same change also edits DotRestApplication's OpenAPI tags (e.g. renames tag 'Experiment' to 'Experiments', adds tags and externalDocs) and openapi.yaml, which changes the generated API document, and it is a judgment whether those count among the 'fixes' the sentence covers. Impact class, left CANNOT_TELL.
